name: Payroller
description_en:
Payroller is Australian payroll software with STP reporting, payslips, leave, employee access and superannuation workflows. Standard provides web and mobile payroll, while a limited Lite mobile option and separate Timesheets & Rosters offering have different conditions.

A successful migration needs opening leave and year-to-date balances plus the software-ID/reporting setup, not just employee names. The promoted first-six-month employee rate is temporary; normal minimum spending, annual upfront billing and GST treatment materially affect a small team’s cost.
description_zh:
Payroller 是澳大利亚工资软件，提供 STP 申报、工资单、休假、员工访问及养老金流程。Standard 支持网页和移动工资，有限 Lite 移动方案及独立 Timesheets & Rosters 各有不同条件。

迁移不仅要员工姓名，还需期初休假、当年累计余额及软件 ID 和申报设置。前六个月优惠人均价是临时的，正常最低消费、年度预付和 GST 会显著影响小团队费用。

core_features.explanation_en: The payroll guide describes a pay run, STP declaration and submission after software-ID registration and reporting setup.
core_features.explanation_zh: 工资指南描述注册软件 ID 及配置后，创建工资、完成 STP 声明并提交。

core_features.explanation_en: Migration includes employee opening leave/YTD values; the employee app provides access to pay information.
core_features.explanation_zh: 迁移包含员工期初休假和年内累计值，员工应用提供工资信息访问。

core_features.name_zh: 通过 Beam 处理养老金
core_features.explanation_en: Documented super batches support employee review, BPAY or direct debit and a separate submission/confirmation process.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档中的养老金批次支持员工审核、BPAY 或直接扣款，以及单独提交确认。

pricing.summary_en: Lite mobile one-person payroll advertised free. Standard AUD5.50/employee minimum22 monthly or annual equivalent3.99 minimum15.96, GST exclusive; eligible0.99 offer six months. Annual upfront and add-on costs matter.
pricing.summary_zh: Lite 宣传一人移动工资免费。Standard 月付人均5.50最低22，年付月等值3.99最低15.96澳元，不含GST；合资格0.99优惠六个月。需计年付预付及附加费。

sources.title: Payroll Only Plan - Starts at 99c/pm per Employee* | Payroller
sources.research_notes_en: Read migration balances, ATO software-ID prerequisite, STP declaration, Beam super batches and Lite footnote; did not assert tax-law changes as verified facts.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.en: The payroll-only guide directs an employer to add employees, open People → employee settings → Opening balances and enter leave and YTD values as of migration. It also requires registering the Payroller software ID with the ATO before enabling STP. For an illustrative mid-year switch, compare imported gross pay, deductions and leave with the previous payroll before the first submission. These are documented dependencies, not an executed ATO registration or filing. Agree handling of historical corrections and duplicates rather than assuming a new employee list resets prior obligations.
sections.zh: 工资指南要求新增员工后进入 People → 员工设置 → Opening balances，录入迁移日的休假及年内累计，并在开启 STP 前向 ATO 登记软件 ID。年中切换示例应在首次提交前对照旧工资核对税前、扣款和休假。这些是文档前置条件，不是已执行 ATO 登记或申报。需约定历史更正和重复记录处理，不能假定新员工列表重置此前义务。

sections.title_en: Separate a pay run, report and super payment
sections.title_zh: 区分工资运行、报告及养老金付款
sections.en: After creating a pay run, the guide shows an STP declaration followed by Submit STP. Superannuation is handled through batches with employees, dates and payment method reviewed separately; BPAY can require an external transfer code, while direct debit has its own processing time. A confirmation message is not the same as all funds clearing or the authority accepting every record. Test a corrected pay run and rejected super batch in a vendor demonstration. Calculation, legal rates, reporting acceptance, bank settlement and exception recovery were not independently tested.
sections.zh: 创建工资后，指南说明需完成 STP 声明再 Submit STP。养老金使用批次，另核对员工、日期及付款方式；BPAY 可能需要外部转账代码，直接扣款也有自身处理时间。确认消息不等于所有资金已结算或机构接受全部记录。应在演示中测试更正工资及被拒养老金批次，计算、法定费率、申报接受、银行结算和异常恢复均未独立测试。

sections.title_en: A free app is a limited payroll option
sections.title_zh: 免费应用对应有限工资范围
sections.en: The Lite card says Free for mobile payroll/STP, and its footnote limits this to app users running payroll for a single person. It does not establish free multi-employee web payroll. Standard lists web/mobile payroll, STP, leave, superannuation and Xero. Timesheets & Rosters is presented as an additional offering, listed at AUD6 per employee monthly or AUD3.99 with annual billing, rather than an automatic part of payroll-only. Free agent-portal access is also distinct from each client’s paid subscription. Verify the exact worker count, platform and add-on scope before choosing a free or paid path.
sections.zh: Lite 卡称移动工资和 STP 免费，脚注限定为仅处理一人工资的应用用户，不能证明多人网页工资免费。Standard 列出网页移动、STP、休假、养老金和 Xero。Timesheets & Rosters 作为附加产品展示，月付每员工 6 澳元或年付月等值 3.99，不是工资单一产品自动包含。免费代理门户与每家客户的收费订阅也不同。选择前需确认人员数、平台和附加范围。

sections.en: The published Standard schedule is AUD5.50 per employee monthly, minimum AUD22, or AUD3.99 monthly equivalent billed annually, minimum AUD15.96. For two employees after the offer, those minimums apply rather than AUD11 or AUD7.98. Eligible new subscribers may pay AUD0.99 per employee monthly for six months, with minimums waived during discounted months. Current terms give a promotional window ending October 30, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM AEST and exclude existing, enterprise/special-contract and agent-invited trial users. Annual fees are paid upfront, covering discounted and standard months; a monthly equivalent is not monthly payment. Terms specify AUD and GST-exclusive prices unless stated otherwise.
sections.zh: Standard 公布价为月付每员工 5.50 澳元、最低 22，或年付月等值 3.99、最低 15.96。优惠后两人企业适用最低金额，而非 11 或 7.98。合资格新订户可前六个月每人每月 0.99，优惠月免最低消费。当前条款规定优惠窗口至 2026 年 10 月 30 日 AEST 23:59:59，排除旧用户、企业特殊合同及代理邀请的试用用户。年费预付，包含优惠和标准月份，月等值不代表月付。条款明确澳元，除另说明外不含 GST。

sections.title_en: Check seats, renewal and refund eligibility
sections.title_zh: 核对席位、续订及退款资格
sections.en: Terms default to automatic renewal unless cancelled before renewal; cancellation ends access at the selected billing-period end. Added seats are prorated, while removed seats remain accessible until the next schedule’s reduced count. The pricing FAQ describes an immediate charge when switching monthly to yearly, whereas general terms describe schedule changes activating after the current period, so confirm the actual checkout transition. First-time direct subscribers may claim the 30-day guarantee; agents and agent-linked subscriptions are excluded and payment-provider fees are not refunded. Payroller may fit Australian small employers, but signed terms, audit retention, full exports, security, hosting, recovery and source-code licensing remain unverified. No tenant, filing or payment was executed.
sections.zh: 条款默认自动续订，需续订前取消；取消在所选计费期结束生效。新增席位按比例收费，移除席位仍可使用至下个计费期人数减少。价格 FAQ 描述月转年时立即扣款，一般条款却称当前期间结束后新周期生效，需确认实际结账过渡。首次直接订户可申请 30 天保障，代理及关联订阅排除，支付商费用不退。Payroller 可用于澳大利亚小雇主评估，但签署条款、审计保留、完整导出、安全、托管、恢复和源代码许可未核实，未执行租户、申报或付款。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
